correctness.rationale: Exact distance formula enumerates all alternating-row triple faces and excludes higher faces. Explicit boundary-cocycle constraints reduce to quadruple identities and an all-field normal form proven by induction. For n≥4 their solution space gives rank(∂2)=2n(n−3); cases n=2,3 direct. UCT converts field-uniform Betti ranks into torsion-free integral homology. Standalone verifier independently recomputes faces and modular boundary ranks for finite cross-checks; no finite check is used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: An explicit integral homological classification and first occurrence of nonzero degree-two homology for a natural infinite graph-metric complex goes substantially beyond known general-position maximum sizes and cardinality polynomials. Uniform char-free rank normal form explains the topology and gives precise motivation for both Betti numbers.
